goal.objective: Determine whether a feasible randomized teacher contrast and a common single terminal response can discriminate the pinned acquisition forecasts from source-anchored rivals at a realistic scale where exact100 or a strong simple alternative cannot. Execute the pinned reference and a bounded development pilot if feasible, challenge model, source/site and observation uncertainty, and quantify the cost and evidence requirements of any credible main design within the November 4 brief.
